description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application. It manages the UI for the home screen, including a top menu (Home, Login, Setting, My Plan), a banner, horizontally scrollable content rails, and a subscriptions row. It handles focus animations and navigation between activities.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: An Android activity representing the TV home screen with navigation menu, content rails, and subscriptions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and calls setup methods for the menu and rails.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Sets up the top navigation menu with focus animations and click handlers for navigation.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Dynamically creates horizontal content rails with focus-aware thumbnails.
